economic_hypothesis: A first upper-limit close after sixty sessions without one publicly reveals a demand shock. If the next session opens near the constrained close, trades back to that close or lower, but finishes at least three percent above it in the upper thirty percent of its range without another limit close, released supply has been absorbed at executable prices rather than hidden behind a locked board.

frozen_signal.first_limit: previous completed session closes at its registered upper limit
frozen_signal.prior_history: twenty completed sessions hard-valid, tradable, market-rule-valid and corporate-action-valid
frozen_signal.coordinate_lineage: unchanged between first-limit and signal sessions

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open after completed supply-test signal, no later than three market sessions

order: highest median annual mean net return
